verdict.rationale: Docs mention a 'Decision Center' where policies for Sale/Checkout events can be configured at checkpoints (signifyd-docs-23, signifyd-docs-21, signifyd-docs-22), implying rule/threshold-based routing of orders, but there is no explicit documentation of mapping specific score ranges to allow/review/block/step-up-3DS actions or of an ops-facing threshold tuning UI. Missing for 10: explicit score-to-action mapping documentation, 3DS step-up integration details, and evidence of adjustable threshold configuration by risk appetite.
